20261121-physics-m3-2.title: Xa isantya semoto endleleni siphindwe
20261121-physics-m3-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Xa isantya semoto endleleni siphindwe ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261121-physics-m3-2.material: Xa isantya semoto endleleni siphindwe kabini ukusuka kwi-50 km/h ukuya kwi-100 km/h, umgama wokubhrekha xa ubhrekha ngxamisekileyo wanda ngamaxesha amalunga nangaphi ngokwethiyori?
20261121-physics-m3-2.s.s1.prompt: Xa isantya semoto endleleni siphindwe kabini ukusuka kwi-50 km/h ukuya kwi-100 km/h, umgama wokubhrekha xa ubhrekha ngxamisekileyo wanda ngamaxesha amalunga nangaphi ngokwethiyori?
20261121-physics-m3-2.s.s1.explain: Kuba umsebenzi wamandla okukhuhlana ngexesha lomgama wokubhrekha $s$ ufunxa amandla ehambayo, $f \cdot s = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \implies s \propto v^2$. Ukuba isantya sibe $2$ amaxesha, umgama wokubhrekha unyuka kakhulu ube $2^2 = 4$ amaxesha.
20261121-physics-m3-2.s.s1.hint.0: Umsebenzi wamandla okukhuhlana phakathi kwetayara nomhlaba (amandla okukhuhlana × umgama wokubhrekha) = amandla ehambayo emoto.
20261121-physics-m3-2.s.s1.hint.1: Kuba amandla ehambayo alingana nesikwere sesantya, umgama wokubhrekha nawo ulingana nesikwere sesantya.

20261119-physics-h1.title: Amaqanda amabini anobunzima obufanayo
20261119-physics-h1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Amaqanda amabini anobunzima obufanayo ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261119-physics-h1.material: Amaqanda amabini anobunzima obufanayo awiswa evela kubude obufanayo ngokulandelelana kumgangatho wesamente nakumcamelo ethambileyo. Uthelekiso olufanelekileyo lwezixa zomzimba ukusuka kwisiquphe sokuchukumisa umhlaba ukuya kokuyeka luluphi?
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.prompt: Amaqanda amabini anobunzima obufanayo awiswa evela kubude obufanayo ngokulandelelana kumgangatho wesamente nakumcamelo ethambileyo. Uthelekiso olufanelekileyo lwezixa zomzimba ukusuka kwisiquphe sokuchukumisa umhlaba ukuya kokuyeka luluphi?
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.explain: Kuba utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo lamaqanda omabini ($\Delta p$) luyafana, umxhuzulane wesantya ($I = F\Delta t$) ufana. Umcamelo wandisa ixesha lokubetha $\Delta t$ kwaye unciphisa amandla aphakathi okubetha $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$ ukuze iqanda lingaqhekeki.
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.hint.0: Kuba awe kubude obufanayo, isantya ngaphambi kokubetha kunye notshintsho lwesantya emva kokuyeka (utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo = umxhuzulane wesantya) iyafana.
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.hint.1: Umcamelo othambileyo uyacinezeleka kwaye wandise ixesha lokubetha (Δt).
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.o.o0: Ubungakanani bomxhuzulane wesantya obufunyenweyo buyafana, kodwa amandla aphakathi aphunyelwa liqanda elisemcamelweni mancinci

20261122-physics-h1-1.title: Ukuphuma okunzulu
20261122-physics-h1-1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Ukuphuma okunzulu ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-physics-h1-1.material: [Ukuphuma okunzulu] Esiphethweni somqolo ophakame ngeemitha ezingama-80 kukhutshwa into enobunzima obu-1 kg ngokuthe tye ngesantya esingama-20 m/s. Umgama oya ngokuthe tye uhamba ngawo kude kufike emhlabeni ngubuphi? (g = 10 m/s², ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya)
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Ukuphuma okunzulu] Esiphethweni somqolo ophakame ngeemitha ezingama-80 kukhutshwa into enobunzima obu-1 kg ngokuthe tye ngesantya esingama-20 m/s. Umgama oya ngokuthe tye uhamba ngawo kude kufike emhlabeni ngubuphi? (g = 10 m/s², ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya)
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.explain: Ixesha lokuwa ngokuthe nkqo ngamasekhondi angu-$80 = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times t^2 \implies t^2 = 16 \implies t = 4$. Kuba intshukumo ethe tye ayitshintshi, umgama ohambwa ngokuthe tye ngu-$x = v_x t = 20\text{ m/s} \times 4\text{ s} = 80\text{ m}$.
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubale ixesha lokuwa t: h = (1/2) g t² → 80 = (1/2) × 10 × t²
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Bala umgama ohamba ngokuthe tye x = v_x × t.

20261122-physics-h1-2.title: Kutheni i-OLED (organic light-emitting
20261122-physics-h1-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Kutheni i-OLED (organic light-emitting ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-physics-h1-2.material: Kutheni i-OLED (organic light-emitting diode) esetyenziswa kwiifowuni ezintsha nakwiscreen seTV ibhityile kunye nokuba nokwahlukana okuhle kunee-LCD zangaphambili?
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Kutheni i-OLED (organic light-emitting diode) esetyenziswa kwiifowuni ezintsha nakwiscreen seTV ibhityile kunye nokuba nokwahlukana okuhle kunee-LCD zangaphambili?
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.explain: I-OLED isebenzisa ifilimu ebhityileyo ye-organic semiconductor ekhupha ukukhanya yodwa xa kuhamba umsinga, ngoko akukho mfuneko yeyunithi yebacklight eqinileyo kwaye ngokucima ipixel kufumaneka ubumnyama obugqibeleleyo obunokwahlukana okungapheliyo.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o0: Ngenxa yokuba isebenzisa izixhobo zomdaniso we-organic ezizikhanyisayo ngaphandle kwebacklight eyahlukileyo
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o1: Ngenxa yokuba i-OLED yolwelo olungasebenzisi mbane konke
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o2: Ngenxa yokuba ngaphakathi kwe-OLED kukho amakhulu amaninzi eefluorescent ezincinci
